name: Fallback and Circuit Breaking
description: If the primary provider fails (error, timeout, rate limit), fall back to the next provider in the ordered list. Circuit breaker tracks consecutive failures and opens the circuit after a threshold to give the provider recovery time. Integrates with the routing policy to exclude unhealthy providers from candidate selection.
purpose: Guarantee request completion even when individual providers fail, by chaining fallback providers and protecting failing providers with circuit breakers.
acceptanceCriteria: Fallback chain is configurable per-request and has a default global order
Circuit breaker tracks consecutive failures per provider+model pair
Circuit states: closed (normal), open (failing, no requests sent), half-open (probing)
Configurable thresholds: failureCount, timeoutMs, successCount to close
Circuit breaker integrates with Router to exclude open circuits from candidates
Half-open probe sends a single request; success transitions to closed, failure back to open
Circuit breaker events emitted for monitoring and alerting
All errors during fallback chain collected and surfaced in final error if all fail
